Prior review retained below:
Read all 240 question mappings, rationales and counterevidence in a separate pass after drafting. Replaced weak extrapolations with specific current NSW and Victorian police-search guidance, NSW genuine-reason firearms rule, NSW adoption eligibility, ABC public-ownership statement and official mining investment evidence. Distinguished national policy from state examples, declarations and advisory recommendations from implemented measures, and 2026 environmental commencement stages from later scheduled provisions. Removed invented day-level publication precision where only a month/year was supported. The causal review withdrew interests and immediate-moral-intuition answers because teachability alone did not justify the comparative claims; national IQ remains unresolved. All remaining answers marked inferred unless expressly supported as direct. This is an AI evidence review, not a human or independent second-agent review. Flag Commons source, public-domain status and downloaded image were checked; no archive, catalogue generation, similarity acceptance or browser integration is claimed. Parent will perform independent audit and integration. Focused continuation on 2026-10-05 by primary OpenAI Codex agent /root: Reread the Australian Temperament Project and ACECQA Element 5.2.2. Searched AIFS and official education material for interests, inheritance, national intelligence and moral biology. Individual development and taught self-regulation do not rank causes of national IQ, general interests or immediate moral reactions. A consultation submission hosted by the education department is not government adoption. All 3 exact question-level gaps remain null/unknown. Existing supported answers, period and cutoff are preserved. This was a focused same-agent research and separate challenge pass, not a complete independent re-review or publication sign-off. Completion review corrected the rationale for secular-religious-14: the additional selected FBT exemption, not ordinary charitable status, supports the retained qualified agreement. Source reread on 5 October 2026. Separate completion pass on 2026-10-05: checked the 3 new educated assumptions against exact question wording, agreement direction, contextual sources and prior withdrawal reasons. These are most-likely provisional estimates, not adopted national causal theories. The distinction between individual and national/racial heredity, immediate intuition and deliberate instruction, and interventions and causal predominance is retained. Assumption IDs: culture-nature-02, culture-nature-05, culture-nature-10. Reviewed neutral-heavy axis rationales: explicit mixed institutions, competing implemented rules and interaction models justify retained neutral choices; uncertainty alone was not used as the neutral rationale. Earlier whole-assessment review is preserved; this continuation does not claim a fresh independent 240-source reread or a human review. Similarity and browser checks are recorded separately after integration.
